result.rationale: The diff adds a fetch to Salesforce's login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token in the getConnection flow before `return new jsforce.Connection({...})`, with no expiry/refresh check — the fetch, parse, and prisma.credential.update run unconditionally on every instantiation, unlike the other services which gate refresh behind token expiry checks. This is a real, verifiable defect introduced by this diff (extra network round-trip and DB write on every use).
